issues.on_page: State receipts 476,338 (p2); Exhibit A lists Property tax relief 194,289, Homestead exemption 2,832, Prorate motor vehicle 1,998
issues.issue: State receipts very likely includes property tax credit, homestead and pro-rate money, which the rules keep out of state aid. No breakdown of the line is printed, so state aid stands, but the rules call for a review note on a line that combines these, and this one has none.

issues.on_page: Inheritance Fund Local receipts 14,496 = Schedule 7 'Interest on taxes' (p12)

This is inconsistent; a split by fund column would be just as well supported.
